name: GPT Image 2 AI Generator & Editor
description_en:
The catalog name GPT Image 2 AI Generator Editor corresponds to Image2 at image2.pro, a hosted workspace for multi-model image generation and reference editing. Its interface lists several model names and advertises marketing assets, posters, UI concepts and product imagery.

The page name does not establish that this service is an official OpenAI product. The public FAQ asks that question without a readable answer, and the generic terms do not establish a provider relationship. Treat platform identity and upstream model verification separately.
description_zh:
目录 GPT Image 2 AI Generator Editor 对应 image2.pro 的 Image2，多模型生成与参考编辑工作空间，界面列若干模型，面向营销、海报、UI 概念及商品图。

名称不证明其为 OpenAI 官方产品；公开 FAQ 只有问题而无可读回答，通用条款未建立提供商关系。平台身份和上游模型验证应分别处理。

core_features.explanation_en: Specify composition or upload an authorized reference and iterate.
core_features.explanation_zh: 描述构图或上传授权参考并迭代。

core_features.explanation_en: Prepare posters or mockups, then inspect rendered text and layout.
core_features.explanation_zh: 准备海报/样机，再核文字及排版。

en: Create and proofread a poster concept with exact event text.
zh: 创建并逐字核准确活动文字海报概念。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm identity, credit and visibility terms, generate a nonconfidential concept and inspect text and export size.
steps.zh: 确认身份/额度/可见性条款，生成非机密概念并核文字及尺寸。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Credit packs/subscription selectors; displayed billing period unresolved.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Displayed tiers $12.9/100 credits, $39.9/400, $99.9/1,400; selector state/billing unclear. Five new-user credits. Per-operation cost, expiry and output rights not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 展示 $12.9/100、$39.9/400、$99.9/1,400 额度，选项状态/账期不明。新用户 5 额度，操作费、到期及输出权利未定。

sources.research_notes_en: Image2 at image2.pro offers multi-model generation/reference editing with public visibility control and five signup credits.

sources.title: Image2 Pricing - Credit Packs & Subscriptions
sources.research_notes_en: 100/400/1400-credit cards $12.9/$39.9/$99.9; tab state not established, not normalized monthly.

sources.title: Terms of Service
sources.research_notes_en: Generic SaaS terms describe advance billing and case-by-case refunds; no clear upstream affiliation or output license established.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Specify the asset and inspect every critical detail
sections.title_zh: 描述素材并核全部关键细节
sections.en: For an illustrative event poster, define hierarchy, exact date, headline and aspect ratio. Compare the generated text character by character and check that the date is not invented or rearranged. A screenshot-style UI concept is an image rather than a functional application. Campaign-ready and high-resolution labels do not verify accessibility or print suitability.
sections.zh: 例如活动海报，应设层级、准确日期、标题及比例，再逐字核文字和日期。截图式 UI 概念只是图片，不是功能应用；可投放/高分辨率标签不验证无障碍或印刷适配。

sections.title_en: Do not infer a billing period from mixed selectors
sections.title_zh: 不要从混合选项推断账期
sections.en: The pricing document presents pay-as-you-go, monthly and annual selectors with Starter $12.9/100 credits, Standard $39.9/400 and Premium $99.9/1,400. Returned text does not establish which selector governs those amounts, so they are displayed pack/tier amounts, not normalized monthly prices. Model/resolution consumption, credit expiration and failed-run refunds remain unknown. New-user five credits are a signup allowance, not proven recurring free use.
sections.zh: 价格页有按量、月及年选择，Starter $12.9/100 额度、Standard $39.9/400、Premium $99.9/1,400。返回文字不明由哪个选项控制，不能归一成月价。模型/尺寸消耗、到期及失败返还未知。新用户 5 额度是注册赠额，不证明重复免费。

sections.title_zh: 核共享及参考数据处理
sections.en: The generator shows a Public Visibility control. Confirm its default and result visibility before uploading a private product or person. The read terms describe prepaid billing and case-by-case refunds but provide no substantive generated-output commercial license or provider affiliation. Obtain the applicable terms rather than infer rights from marketing uses.
sections.zh: 生成器有 Public Visibility 控制，上传私密产品/人物前需核默认和结果可见性。所读条款介绍预付及个案退款，却未明确生成输出商用许可或提供商关系，应获取适用条款而非从营销用途推权利。

sections.title_zh: 承诺生产前试点概念图
sections.en: Image2 may be investigated for rapid visual concepts and authorized reference variants. Test a small poster or product image, inspect text, unchanged regions and export dimensions, and retain a source copy. No model call, visibility setting, credit charge or export was executed; listed model availability, face enhancement and 4K results were not independently measured.
sections.zh: 可研究快速视觉概念和授权参考变体。先小海报/商品图试验，核文字、未修改区域及导出尺寸并保留原图。本文未调用模型、设可见性、扣额度或导出，模型可用、脸部增强及 4K 未独立测。

research_gaps: No model/provider affiliation, generation, privacy setting, credit transaction or export tested.
Billing selector, operation cost/expiry, output license, data handling and self-hosting unknown.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
